title: Agent/JMAP: tell users a member was removed for lacking AppDataUpdate (removed_without_app_data_update)
description: mimi-mls now reports CommitSummary::removed_without_app_data_update / CommitBundle::removed_without_app_data_update (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.37, commit 7346e31). mimid-agent-core/-jmap do not use it yet: surface a system message saying the member's client was removed because it lacks AppDataUpdate and may rejoin. Also consider: in a MIMI room participant_list/room-policy AppDataUpdates still fail while such a member is present.
close_reason: Event::RemovedWithoutAppDataUpdate + JMAP in-chat notice (account sender, idempotent per room/user/epoch); e2e through a hub is follow-up mimid-vx7s; df3f573 (agent-followups)
